description: Hand-pinned shared benchmark operand contract for the standalone BID codec benchmark legs (Go testing.B, Rust criterion, JS and Python scripts). Every entry is a canonical BID encoding whose decimal_string is the codec's exact canonical rendering: encode(decode(bits)) == bits, toString(decode(bits)) == decimal_string, and encode(fromString(decimal_string)) == bits. TestCodecBenchmarkOperandContract (bid754-codec-go/benchmark_test.go) fails on any violation, and every language leg re-checks the same round trips in its benchmark setup before timing. Benchmark infrastructure only; not a regular verification domain.
